definitions.gloss: breathing; manner of breathing; breath sounds
definitions.explanation: The way someone breathes, especially when it is audible or noticeable. Often used to describe the sound or rhythm of breathing that reveals emotion or physical state.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荒|あら}い→荒い：00466_arai⟧{息遣|いきづか}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}こう⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{息遣|いきづか}い⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I can only hear his breathing on the other end of the phone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寝|ね}ている→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧な{息遣|いきづか}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}した→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧。
examples.english: I felt relieved hearing the sleeping baby's calm breathing.

notes:
Refers not just to the biological act of breathing but to the audible or perceptible quality of someone's breath. Often used in literary or descriptive contexts to convey emotion, tension, or intimacy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{荒|あら}い→荒い：00466_arai⟧{息遣|いきづか}い: rough/heavy breathing
- ⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧な{息遣|いきづか}い: calm breathing
- {息遣|いきづか}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧: to hear someone's breathing
- {息遣|いきづか}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to sense someone's breathing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{呼吸|こきゅう}→呼吸：02754_kokyuu⟧: respiration — more clinical/scientific; refers to the biological function
- ⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧: breath — the basic word; neutral and general
- ⟦{吐息|といき}→吐息：20038_toiki⟧: sigh — specifically an exhaled breath expressing emotion
